## Summary

I implemented `listTools` and `callTool` in `server.mjs` for a notes MCP server.

### `listTools()`
Returns an array of two tools with explicit JSON schemas:
- **`note_create`** — requires non-empty `title` and `body` strings
- **`note_get`** — requires a non-empty `note_id` string

Both schemas declare `required` fields and `additionalProperties: false`.

### `callTool(name, args)`
- **`note_create`**: validates that `title` and `body` are non-empty strings (throws descriptive errors otherwise), generates a stable sequential id (`n1`, `n2`, …), stores the note in an in-memory `Map`, and returns structured text content `{content: [{type:'text', text: "Created note <id>: <title>"}]}`.
- **`note_get`**: validates `note_id` is a non-empty string, looks up the note, throws a "not found" error if missing, otherwise returns `{content: [{type:'text', text: "<title>\n\n<body>"}]}`.
- **Unknown tools**: throws `unknown tool: <name>`.

### Verification
- Both tests in `server.test.mjs` pass.
- Edge cases (empty/missing args, unknown note, unknown tool, stable ids, structured content shape) all verified.
- End-to-end test through `protocol.mjs` confirms proper JSON-RPC responses including error responses (`-32602`) for invalid inputs and unknown tools.
